title: Understanding Grouping
text: To calculate the average weight for each chain, you need to group the data by the 'chain' column. This allows you to perform operations like mean on each group separately.

title: Using Groupby
text: The groupby function is used to split the data into groups based on some criteria. Here, you need to group by the 'chain' column to calculate the average weight for each chain.
